title: Spaces in my about section

replies.author: RCMP_Mountie
replies.body: The "About" section of players' profiles use HTML, so type in <br> to insert a line break.
replies.body_tagged: The "About" section of players' profiles use HTML, so type in <br> to insert a line break.
